text:
dmitri: Quick sync — I want to do the vendor lockfile bump + submodule refresh today before cutoff. Plan: open PR that updates vendor/, updates the two submodule SHAs (infra-tools, model-metrics), and runs the lockfile generator in CI. Any objections?
carla: go for it. remind me where we keep the special vendor exclusions for the onprem build?
dmitri: repo:infra/vendor-excludes.md — will double-check that and add a comment in the PR if I touch any excluded paths.
alice: FYI the e2e cluster is flaking on a motd change; could cause the smoke job to fail. If you're running the full acceptance suite, maybe start with ci/e2e-smoke and then ci/full after green.
dmitri: good call. I'll gate merge on ci/e2e-smoke + ci/unit. If smoke fails, I'll ping @alice to help triage.
ben: Heads-up: if you change the model-metrics submodule we'll need a minor version bump for the metrics lib in go.mod. can you include that in the PR?
dmitri: yes — I'll update go.mod and add a changelog line. Also going to leave the package.json pins alone (no npm upgrades) — just the locked vendor artifacts.
jenna: reminder that release cutoff is today at 18:00 UTC. Anything merged after that needs shiproom approval.
dmitri: noted. I'm aiming to open the PR at 15:30 UTC so there's time to iterate.
carla: can you paste the commands you'll run? makes it easier for me to review quickly.
dmitri: sure:
```bash
git checkout -b rel/lockfile-bump-1812
git submodule update --init --recursive
# update submodule SHAs
# run vendor generator
./scripts/generate-vendor-lockfile.sh
git add vendor/ go.mod go.sum path/to/submodule
git commit -m "vendor: lockfile bump + submodule SHAs"
git push origin rel/lockfile-bump-1812
```
carla: looks fine. can you add a short CI matrix flag so the PR runs smoke first? we have an annotation we can use to prioritize jobs.
dmitri: will add `ci-priority: smoke-first` as a PR label and a pipeline annotation.
release-bot: :warning: release-bot reminder: release cutoff at 2027-06-01T18:00:00Z UTC. Merges after cutoff require approval from release leads.
alice: I'll be around for the 15:30–16:30 window to watch the smoke run. ping me if it flakes.
ben: quick ask — can we avoid touching the vendored licensing files unless needed? legal asked we keep their timestamps intact.
dmitri: understood, won't modify licensing files. If the generator rewrites them I'll exclude those diffs.
jenna: also include a short changelog entry: "deps: vendor lockfile bump, submodule SHAs" so release notes catch it.
dmitri: will do. planning to tag the PR with "release-candidate" once smoke passes.
carla: if everything is green, can someone merge with fast-forward only? we had a rebase drama last week.
alice: ok to squash? we usually do fast-forward for rel branches.
dmitri: I'll fast-forward merge. If anything blocks I'll post here and file a post-merge revert plan.
ben: thanks — also leaving a quick TODO: if go vet fails after bump, revert model-metrics submodule and re-run vet locally before reopening.
dmitri: copy. I'll call out in the PR description how to reproduce vet locally.
jenna: thanks all. small ask — after merge, please run `./scripts/propagate-to-dedicated.sh` to ensure Dedicated infra picks up the new vendor package.
dmitri: yep will run that and post the propagation logs here.
release-bot: :white_check_mark: queued: rel/lockfile-bump-1812 will start pipeline in 5m.
dmitri: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/5421 — label `release-candidate`, `ci-priority: smoke-first`.
alice: got the ping, watching now.
carla: thanks — I'll skim the diffs and flag anything suspicious.
dmitri: will update with smoke result. thanks everyone.
